name: Rigret
source:
The goddess of the northern sky who governs over winter, and is the youngest daughter of the 4 goddesses.

Also known as the『Guardian Deity of Ice』.

She governs over crafts, fishing and music(tradition included) from within the country of midwinter in the north surrounded by sub-zero temperatures and snowstorms, Guraz. She is known as a goddess who tests the strength and perseverance of humanity.

As expected of the youngest sister of the 4 goddesses, her youth stands out. While she is a symbol of worship and a goddess who is meant to guide humans, she really just wants to be pampered and fussed over. While she can't exactly show it when in front of humans, she relies very much on her sisters and is dependent on them.

「I-I'm the goddess of this land, Rigret! If you resist, then in the name of the Guardian Deity, I won't forgive you!」

Weapon name: Gjallarjorn

[From [url=http://www.ninetail.tk/tde10/] Ninetail[/url]]
